## Imports
```{python}
import json
from urllib.request import urlopen
import polars as pl
from pyprojroot import here
```

## Save Downloads
```{python}
BASE = 'https://api.openf1.org/v1'

def get_openf1(endpoint):
    """Download from OpenF1 and return a polars table."""
    with urlopen(f'{BASE}/{endpoint}') as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode('utf-8'))
    return pl.DataFrame(data)

## List all 2026 races
sessions = get_openf1("sessions?year=2026&session_name=Race")
print(sessions.select("session_key", "circuit_short_name", "date_start"))


## Pick first race
key = sessions['session_key'][0]

## See drivers in that race
drivers = get_openf1(f"drivers?session_key={key}")
print(drivers.select('driver_number', 'name_acronym', 'team_name'))

## Get telemetry for one driver
num = drivers['driver_number'][0]
car = get_openf1(f"car_data?session_key={key}&driver_number={num}")
print(car.head())
print(car.shape)

## Save a copy so we don't download again
out = here('data/raw')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
car.write_parquet(out / f'car_{key}_{num}.parquet')
```

## Get LapTimes
```{python}
laps = get_openf1(f'laps?session_key={key}&driver_number={num}')
print(laps.select('lap_number', 'date_start', 'lap_duration'))
print(laps.shape)
```

## Matching Telemetry to Laps, Then Add Distance
```{python}
FMT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%.f%z"

## Turn date text into real times
car = car.with_columns(pl.col('date').str.to_datetime(FMT, time_zone='UTC'))
laps = laps.with_columns(pl.col('date_start').str.to_datetime(FMT, time_zone='UTC'))

## Keep laps that have a time and find when each lap ends
laps_ok = (
    laps
    .filter(pl.col('lap_duration').is_not_null())
    .with_columns(
        lap_end=pl.col('date_start')
        + pl.duration(milliseconds=(pl.col('lap_duration') * 1000).cast(pl.Int64))
    )
    .select('lap_number', 'date_start', 'lap_end')
    .sort('date_start')
)

## Give each telemetry row it's lap number
car_laps = (
    car.sort('date')
    .join_asof(laps_ok, left_on='date', right_on='date_start', strategy='backward')
    .filter(pl.col('date') < pl.col('lap_end'))
)

## Distance along each lap (meters)
car_laps = car_laps.with_columns(
    secs=pl.col('date').diff().over('lap_number').dt.total_milliseconds().fill_null(0) / 1000).with_columns(
        distance=(pl.col('speed') / 3.6 * pl.col('secs')).cum_sum().over('lap_number')
)

## Check - each lap should be about 5,300 m (Melbourne's length)
print(car_laps.group_by('lap_number').agg(pl.col('distance').max()).sort('lap_number'))
```
